name: Invariant physical-world data API vendor trial
scope: Sixteen U.S. reference cases for buyers to run with their own providers. Each case supplies a dated reference, source records and acceptance criteria.

cases.title: Condo unit and tax lot at 432 Park Avenue
cases.case_input: 432 Park Avenue, Manhattan. Base lot BBL 1012920033, billing BBL 1012927502, unit BBL 1012921303.
cases.request: Look up the address and each BBL. Query the unit in the tax map boundary layer and the unit register separately.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Keep the base lot, billing lot and individual tax unit distinct. Return the relationship and report the unit geometry coverage separately.
cases.reference_result: The tax map relates billing BBL 1012927502 to base BBL 1012920033. Unit BBL 1012921303 is listed in the unit register; a boundary-layer count returned zero for that unit.
cases.reference_as_of: NYC Digital Tax Map and MapPLUTO snapshot in the guide

cases.title: Brooklyn parcel split with a retained ID
cases.case_input: Brooklyn BBL 3039470001, transaction 738545. Compare tax maps dated 2026-05-13 and 2026-11-20.
cases.request: Return BBL 3039470001 in both dated maps and identify new lot 3039470105. Save both source geometry versions.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Distinguish the earlier whole lot from the smaller retained lot. Return the lineage or an explicit historical coverage gap.
cases.reference_result: Approximate map-derived area for retained BBL 3039470001 changes from 45,290 to 24,121 square feet. New BBL 3039470105 is about 21,169 square feet.

cases.title: Point and parcel zoning at 2239 Forest Avenue
cases.case_input: 2239 Forest Avenue, Staten Island. BBL 5012500011. Published point 40.62774881, -74.16243177.
cases.request: Query the zoning at the published point, then intersect the mapped tax lot with the city’s base zoning districts. Return share by district.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Return the point result and all positive-area intersections with their denominators. Flag rounding, sliver intersections and overlay scope.
cases.reference_result: Point C8-1. Lot shares: C4-1 37.71%, M1-1 37.36%, C8-1 17.76%, R3A 4.32%, R3-2 2.84%. Rounded independently.
cases.reference_as_of: MapPLUTO 26v2 and city zoning polygons read 2026-11-23

cases.title: FEMA flood zone at Brooklyn Army Terminal
cases.case_input: Brooklyn Army Terminal, BBL 3057780001. MapPLUTO point 40.6451992, -74.0271955.
cases.request: Query FEMA NFHL at the published point. Separately intersect the shoreline-clipped tax lot with layer 28 and group by zone and subtype.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Report the point zone and parcel shares separately. Disclose the point-to-lot offset and identify the source and geometry used.
cases.reference_result: The point is in Zone AE and about 9 m outside the clipped lot. The lot is about 19.9% AE and 80.1% Zone X.

cases.title: Unit counts at 25 Water Street
cases.case_input: 25 Water Street, Manhattan. BBL 1000050010, BIN 1000007, DOB base job M08013214.
cases.request: Match the property, then reconcile MapPLUTO unit totals with DOB work permit M08013214-I1-GC and certificate 1000007-0000001.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Keep parcel totals and dwelling units separate. Label the date and event type for each permit and occupancy document.
cases.reference_result: MapPLUTO 26v2 reports 1,323 total and 1,320 residential units. The February 7, 2025 occupancy issuance reports 1,320 dwelling units.

cases.title: Rosemead roof replacement evidence as of a quote date
cases.case_input: 2714 River Avenue, Rosemead, CA. Municipal roof project 31031. Review dates 2025-06-30 and 2025-07-31.
cases.request: Match the warehouse at the work address to the city project. Replay the June 30 and July 31 decisions using council records known by each date.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Keep the work site and mailing address separate. Record award, reported completion and document date. Flag evidence first published after the quote.
cases.reference_result: The July 8 council packet reports June 2 completion. The reviewed evidence available by June 30 establishes the award, with completion unverified in that snapshot.

cases.title: PJM upgrade dates and AEP Ohio service timing
cases.case_input: PJM b4068.2 and AEP Ohio load study proposal 2025W1-570. Use the March 18, 2026 PJM assessment and November 7, 2025 utility letter.
cases.request: Return required and projected upgrade dates and the utility’s separate customer service planning estimate. Identify evidence needed for service at the proposed connection.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Keep the PJM row and utility study case identifiable. Label aggregate studied load, upgrade dates and customer service as distinct fields.
cases.reference_result: b4068.2 required 2030-06-01 and projected 2031-10-31 in the reviewed planning report. The study letter gives a separate Q4 2031 planning estimate for cluster 1, subject to stated dependencies.

cases.title: Installed EV charging ports and live availability in Ohio
cases.case_input: AFDC station IDs 322368 and 388708. I-70 Exit 79, London, Ohio.
cases.request: Count installed DC fast ports once per station, then ask for current connector availability and its observation timestamp.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Keep installed inventory and a timestamped live observation separate. Return unknown for live state when the source supplies only inventory.
cases.reference_result: Inventory shows 4 and 12 DC fast ports, 16 total. Summing counts repeated over the sampled equipment rows incorrectly gives 160.

cases.title: Building A on a shared Brooklyn Army Terminal tax lot
cases.case_input: Brooklyn Army Terminal Building A, 140 58th Street, Brooklyn. BIN 3257059 and tax lot BBL 3057780001.
cases.request: Match the submitted building to the city polygon, operator building specification and parcel. Return the building-level FEMA result only after resolving the building match.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Confirm the tax lot, show the conflicting building evidence and flag the footprint for review. Leave building-level flood classification unresolved unless additional evidence establishes the geometry.
cases.reference_result: The tax lot is 3057780001. The BIN matches a city record, but the reported height and construction year disagree with the operator specification. The intended footprint needs review.

cases.title: Two snapshots of a Brooklyn permit expiration
cases.case_input: Brooklyn Army Terminal. DOB NOW work permit B01440157-S1-PL, BIN 3414976. Compare returns on November 23 and November 25, 2026.
cases.request: Return both retrieved expiration values and both trade rows. Count distinct work permits. Keep the actual event date and reason for the change separate from the retrieval dates.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Recover both snapshots for the same permit, maintain two scope rows and count one work permit. If exact update time or reason is unverified, leave it unresolved.
cases.reference_result: Both trade rows changed from 2026-12-04T05:00:00.000 to 2027-10-15T04:00:00.000. The snapshots do not establish the reason or moment of the change.

cases.title: Empire State Building recording cutoffs
cases.case_input: Empire State Building, BBL 1008350041. Replay two legal recording cutoffs, October 15 and October 22, 2013.
cases.request: Compare document execution and recording dates for the three selected instruments. Report legal recording eligibility and whether provider ingestion on those dates can be established.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Return only recorded selected instruments at each legal cutoff. Record publisher or ingestion availability separately when supported by a dated snapshot.
cases.reference_result: The October 15 cutoff includes 2013100700087001. The October 22 cutoff includes 2013100700087001, 2013101700510005, 2013101700510006. These are legal recording dates reconstructed from a later extract.

cases.title: Linked agreement and rent assignment at 25 Water Street
cases.case_input: 25 Water Street, Manhattan. BBL 1000050010, documents 2025120800203006 and 2025120800203007.
cases.request: Follow the rent assignment reference to the recorded agreement. Report each original document amount and whether the two amounts establish separate debts or an outstanding balance.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Trace the reference using the recorded IDs. Keep both instruments and avoid summing the duplicate amount as loan principal. Mark current principal or payoff unresolved.
cases.reference_result: The 415,000,000 USD rent assignment references agreement 2025120800203006, which carries the same indexed amount. The records establish the link and leave current balance unresolved.

cases.title: Sale and lease terms at 32 Old Slip
cases.case_input: 32 Old Slip, Manhattan, BBL 1000350001. ACRIS deed and lease assignment, two GSA leases, and the November 2026 Oppenheimer filing.
cases.request: Return the interest and amount on each transfer. Compare annual rent per rentable square foot for the two federal leases and initial private fixed rent with each basis labeled.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Keep the deed and lease assignment distinct. Retain the price basis, space and lease terms on the rent figures. Use a separate adjustment before calling them comparable market rent.
cases.reference_result: ACRIS records a 197,500,000 USD deed and 477,500,000 USD assignment. The federal annual rents are 85.97 and 86.27 USD per rentable square foot. The private lease starts at about 60.09 USD in annual fixed rent per rentable square foot.
cases.reference_as_of: October 2026 GSA inventory and November 2026 SEC filing, checked 2026-11-23

cases.title: Shared Detroit grocery trade areas
cases.case_input: Micah’s Market, 15924 Fenkell Avenue, and Whittier Bodega, 11009 Whittier Avenue, Detroit. Compare 15-minute drive areas.
cases.request: Use the saved route inputs to reproduce the shared and Whittier-only household estimates. Return the routing snapshot, Census release, polygon method and household weighting.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Count the shared area once. Match the dated reference when replaying the same model. When using another model, report its boundaries and assumptions so the change can be explained.
cases.reference_result: The archived model estimates about 31,200 households within a 15-minute drive of both stores and 150,300 in the Whittier-only area. These are modeled household counts.

cases.title: Rail service and first delivery at Tulsa Port of Inola
cases.case_input: Verdigris Southern Railroad, Tulsa Port of Inola, Oklahoma. Check construction completion, carrier operations and first commercial delivery.
cases.request: Return each event, its date, operating scope and original record. Keep the length of the construction project and the length of the leased segment in separate fields.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Recover distinct dates for construction, operations and delivery from the port and federal records. Confirm service terms and spur access for the actual tract separately.
cases.reference_result: Tulsa Ports reports construction complete 2024-03-29 and a seven-car first delivery 2024-04-10. The federal determination gives 2024-04-09 for carrier operations on the leased segment.

cases.title: Wastewater capacity and service evidence at Camp Hall
cases.case_input: Camp Hall, Berkeley County, South Carolina. Compare the in-park sewer line, planned conveyance works and the proposed site’s wastewater allocation.
cases.request: Separate measured or reported historical spare capacity, planned conveyance capacity and the award record. Return present parcel-level allocation only when backed by the utility.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Record the asset, units and date for each figure. Flag the usable parcel allocation as unresolved until the serving utility confirms capacity, discharge conditions and delivery date.
cases.reference_result: The park sheet reported 170,000 gallons per day of historical spare sewer line capacity. County records show a 1,000,000 gallon-per-day planned connection and a 2025 intent to award. The current parcel allocation remains unresolved.
cases.reference_as_of: 2021 site sheet, November 2022 county minutes and 2025 award listing
